Proposition
[Developing-map criterion] 1. Proposition 8.3.2\group convex hyperbolic manifoldsSource: thurston:page-0192 A complete hyperbolic manifold is convex exactly when its developing map identifies its universal cover homeomorphically with a convex subset of $H^n$.
Proof

\sketch Convexity of the developing image straightens lifted paths. Conversely, path straightening proves injectivity of the developing map and convexity of its image.

□
